title: Licensure fees.
bodyText:
[Section effective until June 30, 2026. For section effective July 1, 2026, see below.] Licenses shall be valid for three years and shall be renewed triennially. Any applicant for renewal of a license that has expired within one year of the renewal deadline shall be required to pay a restoration fee in addition to all renewal fees. [L 1998, c 159, pt of §2]

§451J-9 Licensure fees. [Section effective July 1, 2026. For section effective until June 30, 2026, see above.] Except as otherwise provided in section 451J-7.2, licenses shall be valid for three years and shall be renewed triennially. Any applicant for renewal of a license that has expired within one year of the renewal deadline shall be required to pay a restoration fee in addition to all renewal fees.
bodyHtml:
[§451J-9]  Licensure fees.  [Section effective until June 30, 2026.  For section effective July 1, 2026, see below.]  Licenses shall be valid for three years and shall be renewed triennially.  Any applicant for renewal of a license that has expired within one year of the renewal deadline shall be required to pay a restoration fee in addition to all renewal fees. [L 1998, c 159, pt of §2]

 

 

     §451J-9  Licensure fees.  [Section effective July 1, 2026.  For section effective until June 30, 2026, see above.]  Except as otherwise provided in section 451J-7.2, licenses shall be valid for three years and shall be renewed triennially.  Any applicant for renewal of a license that has expired within one year of the renewal deadline shall be required to pay a restoration fee in addition to all renewal fees. [L 1998, c 159, pt of §2; am L 2024, c 93, §7]
